summary: Day 2 of 72 — Diagnostic Error Log Deep-Dive + Fraction-to-Percentage Chart. Forensic post-mortem of Day 1 mock (classify every miss: Conceptual Gap / Misread Trap / Time Exhaustion), then Rodha percentage drills + 1 Matrix Grid DILR set + VARC autopsy. Official urgency: CAT registration closes Tue 22 Sep 5:00 PM IST. Germany Sept items are personal targets (not official deadlines).

urgent_alerts.title: CAT 2026 Registration Close
urgent_alerts.action: Submit CAT 2026 registration on iimcat.ac.in: 6 city preferences + fee (₹2,700 Gen) before the 5:00 PM IST cutoff.

blocks.title: DSA — 2 LeetCode problems
blocks.details: Solve 2 problems from DSA Master Tracker (1 Medium + 1 Easy/Review). Write approach + edge cases before coding.

blocks.title: Job — Sunday inbox & portal scout
blocks.details: Sunday (not a Mon/Wed batch day): reply to any inbound recruiter messages, confirm availability, and scout 3–5 roles on Instahyre/LinkedIn for Monday's application batch. Do not send cold outreach unless already drafted for review.

blocks.title: Breakfast
blocks.details: Eat breakfast; no screens for study tasks.

blocks.title: CAT Day 2 — QA percentages + DILR matrix (forensic)
blocks.details: Quant: 20 Percentage Change & Successive Percentage Change problems (Rodha); verify multiplier shortcuts; log every error as Conceptual Gap / Misread Trap / Time Exhaustion. DILR: 1 Matrix Grid set (Anastasis DILR 200 Sets — Set 1); write grid-setup protocol in DILR journal. Also finish any remaining Day 1 QA/DILR diagnostic autopsy.

blocks.title: Lunch break
blocks.details: Lunch + short walk. No new CAT/job tabs.

blocks.title: Germany — Sep personal targets (not official deadlines)
blocks.details: TARGET (self-imposed ~Tue 22 Sep), not statutory: (1) Anabin H+ check for MDU Rohtak — save PDF. (2) dMAT status on aps-india.de/dmat & g.a.s.t. — if closed/unavailable, plan Winter 2027/28 branch. (3) Run Passau interactive apply guide (route: direct vs uni-assist; no VPD). (4) Draft/send MDU email for 100% English MOI letter + cohort ranking. English bar correction: Passau accepts IELTS 5.5 (B2) OR a 100% English MOI letter — not 6.5. Skip Passau summer freeze actions until status.branch is set to summer.

blocks.title: Tea / transition
blocks.details: Tea break; reset before VARC block.

blocks.title: CAT Day 2 — VARC diagnostic autopsy
blocks.details: Question-by-question review of Day 1 Diagnostic VARC passages. Open Gejo Speaks RC Mechanics Module 1 on CL MyZone. Update Career Launcher MyZone error log (same 3-way miss taxonomy).

blocks.title: Exercise / walk
blocks.details: 45 min walk or workout. End focused study for the day.

blocks.title: Evening wind-down
blocks.details: Light review of tomorrow (Day 3: Percentages Mastery) only if energy remains. Sleep by 22:30.
